purpose: identify which side limits the C6 S2 reference-uncertainty criterion (u_ref = VigilODE dense rtol 1e-12 vs Radau rtol 1e-13)
finding: Radau converges (rtol 1e-12 and 1e-13 within 1.4e-12 and 3.6e-13 of rtol 1e-14), so the reference is accurate to ~4e-13. VigilODE dense at rtol 1e-12/1e-13/1e-14 differs from Radau(1e-14) by 1.2e-11/8.9e-12/3.5e-12: the preregistered u_ref measured the method's own tight-tolerance roundoff floor at gamma=1e6, not reference uncertainty. The rtol 1e-8 rung error 3.6e-11 is within ~3x of that floor.
implication: C6 criterion definition defect plus a real double-precision accuracy floor of RODAS5P at gamma=1e6 (~1e-11 relative); no adapter defect indicated. P02 verdict FAIL stands; a new node (P02b) with a corrected reference-uncertainty definition is required before P03-P06.
